_doc: Test/reference car models for carpipe. 'file' is relative to _cache/models/<id>/ (fetch_models.py downloads them). Per-model keys are pipeline config overrides: length (studs), front (+x/-x/+y/-y, in the file's Blender axes after import), up, textures {material: image}, roles {regex: Role}, budget {Object: tris}.
